page.overview:
What is Hardmode Animatronics?

The hardmode animatronics are recolored animatronic counterparts who appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted, exclusive to blacklight modes.

Their appearance is exactly the same to the original counterparts, except reskinned with different textures to reflect the blacklight modes.

Dark Freddy is the hardmode counterpart of the original Freddy Fazbear colored in pitch black saving for the white glowing eyes and teeth, reminiscent to the original Shadow Freddy from Five Nights at Freddy's 2.

In the blacklight mode of Freddy's level from the Parts and Service mode, he serves as the original Freddy's replacement with the same functions. Dark Freddy appears alongside dark versions of Nightmare Freddy's Freddles, who appear on top above Dark Freddy at the beginning of the round. One of them ends up glitching and briefly replaces the watch that is required to be removed from the circuitry of Freddy's chest.
